title: Duplicate billing charge
case_text: Hi, I was charged twice for my monthly subscription this morning. Please fix this and refund the extra payment.

title: Critical login issue for admin user
case_text: Our admin user cannot log in and the whole team is blocked from accessing the dashboard. We need urgent help immediately.

title: Very negative complaint about support quality
case_text: This has been an awful experience. Your support team keeps giving us copy-paste answers and nobody is solving the problem.

title: Feature request from happy customer
case_text: We really like the product overall. It would be great if you could add an export to Excel option for reports.

title: Onboarding setup help before training
case_text: We just started using the platform and need help configuring our first workflow and user permissions.

title: Cancellation request with high churn risk
case_text: We are considering canceling because the platform is no longer meeting our needs and leadership wants alternatives reviewed this week.

title: Negative sentiment but low churn risk
case_text: I am frustrated that this invoice is confusing and the wording is really poor, but we are not planning to leave. I just want someone to explain the charges clearly.

title: Neutral tone with high churn risk
case_text: Please confirm the steps to export our historical data and end service at the end of the current contract term. We are reviewing replacement vendors.

title: Account access issue for finance manager
case_text: Our finance manager cannot access the billing area after resetting the password and needs entry before end-of-day reconciliation.

title: Technical issue with intermittent outage
case_text: The API has been failing intermittently for the last hour and several requests are timing out in production.

title: Regulatory complaint about data export rights
case_text: We need an immediate explanation for why our customer data export request has not been fulfilled. Our legal and compliance teams are reviewing whether this violates our regulatory obligations and data access rights.

title: Possible security incident affecting enterprise account
case_text: We observed suspicious login activity on an enterprise administrator account and need this investigated immediately. Our security team is concerned there may have been unauthorized access.

title: Executive escalation over failed production rollout
case_text: Our VP is now involved because the rollout failed during a customer-facing launch and we need direct ownership from your side today.

title: Audit request for billing records
case_text: Our finance and audit teams require a full explanation of historical invoice adjustments and credit changes before our compliance review closes tomorrow.

title: Legal review of contract termination process
case_text: Our legal team is reviewing the contract termination language and needs confirmation of the exact offboarding steps, retained data policy, and service end timeline.

title: Complaint mentioning regulator escalation
case_text: If this complaint is not resolved promptly, we are prepared to raise it with the relevant regulator because we do not believe your handling meets your obligations.
